title: Synthetic connection study

shots.event: A reaching hand creates a light path
shots.action: Lean, reach, pause as the path falls short
shots.transition: Follow the leading edge toward the gap

shots.event: The other person extends the missing section
shots.action: A reciprocal gesture closes the gap
shots.transition: Carry the joining light into a wider view

shots.event: Both step onto the shared bridge
shots.action: One deliberate step each, then a shared stillness

notes: Synthetic timings for validating the handoff. No media or render is included.
